name: ai-gateway
description: An ai provider on any OpenAI-compatible gateway (Cloudflare AI Gateway, OpenRouter, Vercel AI Gateway) through @ai-sdk/openai-compatible, with `vendor/model` ids; needs a gateway account and key.

envVars.AI_GATEWAY_URL: Required while AI_PROVIDER=gateway, and may stay blank under any other provider. Base URL of the gateway's OpenAI-compatible API, without `/chat/completions`: `https://api.cloudflare.com/client/v4/accounts/<ACCOUNT_ID>/ai/v1` for Cloudflare AI Gateway, `https://openrouter.ai/api/v1` for OpenRouter, `https://ai-gateway.vercel.sh/v1` for Vercel AI Gateway. Unset, `model()` throws AiError("not_configured").
envVars.AI_GATEWAY_API_KEY: Required while AI_PROVIDER=gateway, and may stay blank under any other provider. The gateway's key, sent as `Authorization: Bearer <key>`: a Cloudflare API token with the Workers AI Read permission, an OpenRouter key, or a Vercel AI Gateway key. Store it as a Workers secret (`wrangler secret put AI_GATEWAY_API_KEY`), never in wrangler.jsonc. A wrong key surfaces as AiError("auth") with retryable false.
envVars.AI_GATEWAY_HEADERS: Optional extra request headers as a JSON object of strings, such as `{"cf-aig-gateway-id":"main"}` to pick a named Cloudflare gateway, or `{"HTTP-Referer":"https://example.com","X-OpenRouter-Title":"My app"}` for OpenRouter's app ranking. Blank sends none. The env check refuses anything that is not an object of strings.

removeWarnings: Removing this module does not revoke the gateway key. Revoke AI_GATEWAY_API_KEY in the gateway's dashboard when nothing else uses it, and delete the Workers secret with `wrangler secret delete AI_GATEWAY_API_KEY`.
`AI_GATEWAY_URL`, `AI_GATEWAY_API_KEY` and `AI_GATEWAY_HEADERS` stay in packages/env/.env. Delete them by hand, and switch AI_PROVIDER to another installed provider first, or `createAi(env)` throws.
